title: IMURUN
summary: Local-first AI chat on its own C++ engine, FISH
desc: Local-first AI chat with its own inference engine, FISH — a C++ engine that runs GGUF models on your own CPU. A Python server handles sessions, tools and connectors, and the Liquid Paper UI runs in a native window or the browser. No account, no API key, no telemetry.
detail: IMURUN is ImuTechz's local-first AI chat. Its inference engine, FISH, is written in C++ and runs GGUF models on the CPU of your own machine, so nothing leaves it. A Python server manages sessions, tools and connectors, and the Liquid Paper UI opens in a native window or in the browser. It runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, installs with pip install imurun (npx imurun is a thin launcher), and is MIT licensed, public and built in the open. Docs live at imutechz.in/imu/docs.
highlights: Own C++ inference engine, FISH, running GGUF models on the CPU
Python server for sessions, tools and connectors
Liquid Paper UI in a native window or the browser
No account, no API key, no telemetry

title: Hosteler
desc: An online shop built around hostel-student needs — essentials, wishlist, cart, student discounts and free delivery across India, plus web solutions for small businesses.
detail: Hosteler is a live e-commerce platform tailored for hostel and student life. It offers a product catalogue (essentials, snacks, dorm gear), cart and wishlist, student-discount pricing, and free pan-India delivery, alongside a 'Web Solutions' arm that builds sites for small businesses. Shubham designed the data model, checkout/REST flows and deployment.

title: Learnify
summary: Check & Mate: a learning-management portal (began as an AI study companion)
desc: Learnify is now Check & Mate, a digital capacity-building and learning-management portal built for Innova 5.0: trainers build courses, trainees sit assessments, and every attempt rolls up into competency reports. It began as an AI learning companion for Indian students.
detail: Check & Mate is a digital capacity-building and learning-management portal, built for the Innova 5.0 project. Trainers build and publish courses through a 5-step resumable wizard (basics, structure, content, tests, review), trainees work through video, reading and link lessons and sit formal assessments, and every attempt rolls up into competency and performance reporting. Three roles share one codebase: trainee, trainer (gated by administrator approval) and administrator (invite-only). Groq drafts questionnaires that trainers review and edit before anything is published, and performance reports are Veda-branded, with deterministic scoring plus an AI narrative and runtime SVG charts. Learnify began as an AI learning companion for Indian students, with college discovery, career guidance, scholarships and a multilingual assistant, Veda AI, before it was rebuilt into Check & Mate.
highlights: AI-drafted questionnaires: draft, edit, then publish
Began as an AI learning companion for Indian students

title: Veda AI
summary: The multilingual assistant in Learnify's first version
desc: Veda was the AI assistant in Learnify's first version, an AI learning companion for Indian students: it answered college, career and scholarship questions in Hindi, English, Bengali & Tamil. Learnify is now Check & Mate, where the Veda name lives on in its performance reports.
detail: Veda AI was the conversational assistant inside the first version of Learnify, an AI learning companion for Indian students. It used LLMs with RAG and vector memory to give multilingual guidance (Hindi, English, Bengali, Tamil) on colleges, careers, scholarships and study planning. Learnify has since been rebuilt into Check & Mate, a learning-management portal, whose performance reports carry the Veda name.

title: ImuTechz — Agents & Skills Directory
summary: 10,631 open-source agents & skills, free to browse
desc: A free index of 10,631 open-source entries — 8,034 agents and 2,597 skills across 23 categories. Browse it, search it in plain language, save what you like and download directly.
detail: The ImuTechz directory re-harvests the open-source ecosystem from GitHub on demand — dead entries drop, taglines get repaired and provenance is kept on every row. Search works in the words a developer would actually say, and 49 QA tests gate every build. Public repos, auditable history: maintenance in daylight.

title: imutechz-web
summary: The ImuTechz website — Next.js, Supabase, docs-as-code
desc: The ImuTechz website — Next.js and Supabase, documentation compiled from markdown at build time, an animated scene on every route. Self-deployed from GitHub to Vercel.
detail: imutechz-web is the ImuTechz website: a Next.js front end over a Supabase back end, with the IMURUN guides compiled from the same markdown the CLI ships with — one source of truth, rebuilt on every deploy. An animated background scene runs on every route, and the whole catalog pipeline (harvest, repair, dedupe, test) lives in the repo.

title: ChhayaTaru Cafe
summary: Cafe website for a Howrah coffee house
desc: A warm, bilingual cafe site for ChhayaTaru (Shibpur, Howrah) — menu, gallery, about, and table booking, tuned for local discovery.
detail: ChhayaTaru Cafe's website showcases the cafe's menu, interiors and story, with online table-booking and directions. Built as a fast Next.js site with server-rendered images, bilingual (Bengali/English) copy and a booking flow, it helps a local Howrah cafe get discovered online.

title: Reciprocity
desc: An academic accountability register that helps students commit to and track goals publicly with peers — turning intent into measured progress.
detail: Reciprocity is an Academic Accountability Register: a web app where students log commitments and track follow-through, adding a light social/peer layer of accountability to studying. Deployed live on Render.

title: GRBS
desc: GRBS (GPT Roadmap By Shubham) is a personal roadmap & progress tracker — dashboard, roadmap, projects, progress, goals, DSA track and company prep, saved locally.
detail: GRBS is a self-contained roadmap and progress tracker. It gives a Dashboard plus Roadmap, Projects, Progress, Goals, DSA Track and Companies sections to plan and measure prep, persisting everything offline in the browser. Built as a lightweight web app.
